verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The implementation resolves ownership from the latest applicable label event, requires both a machine-account signal and the normalized explicit orchestrator allowlist before treating a nearby class= comment as a receipt, conservatively exempts unresolved ownership, and wires event retrieval into the live held-PR path. Focused tests exercise the real ownership, classification, census, finding-rendering, and live-fetch integration paths. Findings remain empty as in round 2, so progress is stagnant.
